# ProAppStore

> ProAppStore is a paid app marketplace where developers publish professional PWA apps at `<name>.proappstore.online`. Apps are built with TypeScript, React, and Vite, deployed via Cloudflare Pages. The platform provides an SDK with auth, per-app SQL databases, file storage (R2), real-time rooms (uncapped), Stripe subscriptions, server-side AI, maps, push notifications, and SMS. One $9/month subscription unlocks all Pro apps; creator payouts are split from the pool by usage share (minus 10% platform fee). For the full AI agent guide, see [skills.md](https://proappstore.online/skills.md).

## AI Agent Integration

- [skills.md](https://proappstore.online/skills.md): Complete platform guide for AI agents. Tech stack, SDK reference (auth, db, storage, subscriptions, rooms, AI, maps, push, SMS), CLI commands, deploy flow. Point your AI agent here.
- [MCP Server](https://mcp.proappstore.online/mcp): Remote MCP server. Connect with `npx mcp-remote https://mcp.proappstore.online/mcp`. Beyond platform tools, **every published app can expose its own tools** (declared in an `mcp.json` manifest, registered automatically on publish) — an external AI calls them as `<app>/<tool>`. See skills.md › MCP Server.
- **Agent customization**: Agent Teams build apps for you, and every agent's identity, system prompt, skills, and model are tunable per project (`GET /v1/projects/:slug/agents` to see them all; `PUT /v1/projects/:slug/roles` to tune the build roles). See skills.md › Agent Teams.
- [Platform Skills (FAS)](https://freeappstore.online/skills.md): Shared platform guide covering conventions used across the store family.

## SDK

- [@proappstore/sdk on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@proappstore/sdk): Platform SDK. `initPro()` gives you auth, per-app D1 database, R2 file storage, real-time rooms, Stripe subscriptions, AI, maps, push notifications, SMS, React hooks, and UI components.
- [SDK Docs](https://proappstore.online/docs): Full SDK documentation with examples.
- [UI Component Library](https://proappstore.online/docs/ui): Live preview of ProShell, ProBadge, SubscriptionStatus, UpgradeCard, BillingButton, GateScreen, and more.

## CLI

- [@proappstore/cli on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@proappstore/cli): CLI for scaffolding, compliance checks, and publishing. Commands: `pas create`, `pas check`, `pas publish`.

## For Developers

- [Build with AI](https://proappstore.online/build-with-ai): Step-by-step guide to building a Pro app with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or any AI tool.
- [Get Started](https://proappstore.online/get-started): Manual setup guide without AI.
- [Guidelines](https://proappstore.online/guidelines): Tech stack, project structure, compliance checks.
- [Developers](https://proappstore.online/developers): Browse registered developers and their apps.
